resources.string:
• Scan a barcode, or type a name in the search box.
• No barcode (loose vegetables, kuih…)? Tap Items and pick it.
• A barcode the till does not know? It asks to add the product first.
• Tap a line on the bill to change how many, or to remove it.

• Scan a barcode, type a name in the search box, or tap an item on the left.\n• A barcode the till does not know? It asks to add the product first.\n• Tap a line on the bill to change how many, or to remove it.
Cash: tap what the customer gave
%1$s has already been paid on this bill. Cancel the payment and clear it?
Only %1$s in cash? Then %2$s is still to pay with another method. (To type RM50, press 5 0 0 0.)
Cash, card, e-wallet / QR, and your own such as DuitNow or Touch ’n Go
Each method is counted on its own in the shift and sales reports. Only cash is rounded to 5 sen; the others pay the exact amount.
Sales already paid with “%1$s” will show “%2$s” too: on receipt copies, in reports and on closed shift reports. To keep the old name on them, add a new payment method and hide this one instead.

A manager\'s PIN allows discounts and price changes on this bill until it is paid, held or cleared. It also shows the manager\'s other jobs (the cash drawer, refunds, Manage shop); each of those asks for the manager\'s PIN again.
Adding a product needs a manager\'s PIN. The manager then adds it, and it goes on this bill.
No product has barcode %1$s yet. A manager can add it now (their PIN first): it is saved for next time and goes on this bill.
Please tell the shop owner: they can fix this in Menu → Manage shop → Settings.
